'''Renata Reisfeld''' ({{Langx|he|רנטה ריספלד}}; née '''Sobel''') is an [[Israelis|Israeli]] Professor of Chemistry and D.H.C. Enrique Berman Professor of Solar Energy at Institute of Chemistry of the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]], author of 532 scientific papers cited more than 30,000 times.

== Biography ==
[[File:Rina and Eliezer.jpg|thumb|Rina and Eliezer]]
[[File:Research group of Professor Renata Reisfeld.jpg|thumb|Center - Professor Renata Reisfeld, right - researcher Viktoria Levchenko, left - researcher Tsiala Saraidarov]]
Renata Sobel was born in [[Chelm]], Poland in 1930.<ref>Jew of the Week: [https://www.jewoftheweek.net/2021/04/08/jew-of-the-week-renata-reisfeld/ "Renata Reisfeld: The Renowned Chemist Who Survived the Holocaust—and Entebbe"]</ref> She came to Israel in 1950 and graduated from the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]].
Her husband is Lazar Eliezer Reisfeld; her children are Danny and Gideon.{{citation needed |date=July 2011}}

Reisfeld became the head of the science research team at The Institute of Chemistry of the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]] in 1975. Reisfeld's research interests are [[luminescent solar concentrator]]s for decreasing the price of [[photovoltaic electricity]], interaction of [[nanoparticles]] with luminescent species, anti-reflecting coating, and [[Sol-Gel]] glasses.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://fr.jpost.com/servlet/Satellite?cid=1255204764378&pagename=JPost%2FJPArticle%2FPrinter |author=Judy Siegel-Itzkovich |date=October 10, 2009 |title=New World: New light on solar energy |newspaper=The Jerusalem Post}}</ref>
She began developing solar concentrators with her research team in 1978.<ref>{{cite journal |title= Planar solar energy converter and concentrator based on uranyl-doped glass |author1= Renata Reisfeld |author2= Samuel Neuman |journal= Nature |date= July 13, 1978 |volume= 274 |issue= 5667 |pages= 144–145 |doi= 10.1038/274144a0 |bibcode = 1978Natur.274..144R |s2cid= 4188054 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |title= Improved planar solar converter based on uranyl neodymium and holmium glasses |author1= Renata Reisfeld |author2= Yehoshua Kalisky |journal= Nature |date= January 17, 1980 |volume= 283 |issue= 5744 |pages= 281–282 |doi= 10.1038/283281a0 |bibcode = 1980Natur.283..281R |s2cid= 4311504 }}</ref>

From 2007 until 2010, Reisfeld acted at [[GreenSun Energy]] Ltd as Chief Scientist.<ref>{{cite news |title= Solar energy in Israel: It's knockout |newspaper= The Economist |date= 23 July 2009 |url= https://www.economist.com/science-and-technology/2009/07/23/its-a-knockout |access-date= 7 July 2011 }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title= Solar cover on the walls |work= The Marker |date= 30 July 2009 |url= http://www.themarker.com/misc/1.543627 }} (in Hebrew)</ref><ref>{{cite news |title= New tech could coat buildings in efficient solar-energy panels |author= Avi Bar-Eli |work= Haaretz |date= 30 July 2009 |url= https://www.haaretz.com/print-edition//new-tech-could-coat-buildings-in-efficient-solar-energy-panels-1.281015 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20121104230800/http://www.haaretz.com/print-edition/new-tech-could-coat-buildings-in-efficient-solar-energy-panels-1.281015 |url-status= dead |archive-date= November 4, 2012 |accessdate= 7 July 2011 }}</ref>

On 4 July 1976, Reisfeld was among the [[Operation Entebbe|102 hostages rescued by Israeli troops at the airport of Entebbe]], Uganda. A week earlier, she had been a passenger aboard Air France flight 139 from Tel Aviv via Athens to Paris that was abducted by a commando of Palestinian and German air pirates attempting to press for the release of 55 mainly Palestinian prisoners held in Israel and other countries on terrorism charges. Reisfeld was one of several witnesses who shared their experiences in media interviews immediately after their return to Israel<ref>{{cite news|title=Anti-Hijack Leader Credits Surprise For Raid's Success|url=https://cdnc.ucr.edu/cgi-bin/cdnc?a=d&d=DS19760705.2.4|accessdate=26 June 2017|work=Desert Sun|agency=UPI|date=5 July 1976}}</ref> as well as on the occasion of the event's 40-year anniversary.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Reisfeld|first1=Smadar|title=רינה רייספלד, מחטופי טיסה 139 של אייר פראנס: "החוטפים היו משכילים, השיחות איתם היו מרתקות"|url=https://www.haaretz.co.il/magazine/.premium-1.2961762|accessdate=26 June 2017|work=Haaretz|date=1 June 2016|language=Hebrew}}</ref>

==Recognition==
In 1993 she received an [[Honorary degree]] – [[Doctor Honoris Causa]] from the [[University of Lyon]], France.<ref>Video (Part 1): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j6ECAV9jqK8 Video (Part 2): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V16c9uDfshA</ref>
In 1993 she was awarded the Medal for scientific achievement of [[Mayor]] [[Lyon]], France.<ref>Video from the [[Mayor]] [[Lyon]]: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kcML-GwVGcc.</ref>
In 1998 she received an Honorary degree – Doctor Honoris Causa from the [[University of Bucharest]], [[Romania]].
In 2005 she received an Honorary degree –  Professor Honoris Causa from the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]], [[Wrocław]], [[Poland]].<ref>Video at the Polish Academy of Science, Wrocław, Poland: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9lLWoxK-_3E Video from the Ceremony from The Hebrew University of Jerusalem with Ambassador of Poland (Part 1): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8UyLt8vpPic (Part 2): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V16c9uDfshA</ref>
In 2010 she was awarded the Gold Medal of the [[University of Wrocław]], Poland.

In 2018, the ''[[Journal of Luminescence]]'' published a special issue in honor of Reisfeld.<ref>{{Cite journal|url=https://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.jlumin.2017.10.030|doi = 10.1016/j.jlumin.2017.10.030|title = Preface|year = 2018|last1 = Boulon|first1 = Georges|last2 = Strek|first2 = Wieslaw|journal = Journal of Luminescence|volume = 193|pages = 1–2|bibcode = 2018JLum..193....1B|url-access = subscription}}</ref> In 2018, [[Elsevier]] highlighted her contributions to physics.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Journals in Physics and Astronomy |url=https://www.elsevier.com/subject/physics-and-astronomy/journals |access-date=2025-05-21 |website=www.elsevier.com |language=en-us}}</ref> In 2020, the International Sol-Gel Society established the Renata Reisfeld Fellowship.<ref>{{cite web |title=Professor Renata Reisfeld - ISGS |url=https://www.isgs.org/community/professor-renata-reisfeld/ |website=www.isgs.org |date=30 June 2020}}</ref>
